# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly  <sub>[v4 c28 P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012), [v4 c30 P1](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c11 P21](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried  <sub>[v4 c11 P21](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0021), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen  <sub>[v3 c11 P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant and housekeeper  <sub>[v3 c11 P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is a stern-visaged woman. She has notable opinions on ears, admiring small, well-shaped ears on men.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008)_

## Personality

Tabitha is a stern, opinionated, but ultimately good-natured and loyal domestic worker who takes great pride in her culinary skills. She is deeply devoted to those she serves and is particularly fond of children. Although she maintains a practical, no-nonsense attitude and frequently complains about men and household mishaps, she harbors a secret desire for romance and marriage.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 c14 P0](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0000), [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 c22 P9](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0009)_

## Goals

- To faithfully care for Nell and her household  <sub>[v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>
- To eventually find a husband  <sub>[v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005), [v4 c22 P9](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0009)</sub>

## History

Tabitha Pratt was initially hired as a general servant at the Glen by Miss Rosalind. In that role, she worked diligently and developed a strong loyalty to Nell Harcourt. During the summer before Nell's marriage, Tabitha was employed at the small house of dreams to assist Nell and manage the domestic chores. She took immense pride in cooking for Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell, remaining a fixture in the household during Nell's pregnancy and the birth and loss of her first child. When her sister Matilda broke her leg, Tabitha temporarily departed to nurse her, but she eventually returned to Nell's service. She later moved with Hugh and Nell when they relocated to their new home in the Glen.

_Sources: [v3 c11 P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c36 P0](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0000), [v4 c40 P10](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Originated from the Glen and never received a marriage proposal in her youth  <sub>[v3 c11 P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v4 c22 P5](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0005)</sub>
- Had a sister named Matilda who married James Clow  <sub>[v3 c38 P4](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0004)</sub>
